Calculation of design shear resistance:

The design ultimate shear resistance of the concrete alone F, should be separately
considered for sections uncracked in flexure and sections cracked in flexure, as
different formulae are required for evaluation, For sections with inclined
tendons, the effects of the inclination of the tendons should be incorporated. If
necessary, shear reinforcement should be provided.
